descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S24 「现成 spec：每次文本生成调用都记录回答的模型和数据去了哪家供应商」 Existing specs: each text-generation call records the model that answered and the vendor the data went to

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Each run records which AI ran each step: the note model, the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when ambient is on), and the models for pre-round processing, photo capture and A …（UAT 3.9；UAT 3.1；TFA-94423 AC 7）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given provider-fallback.spec.ts fixtures and an api session on the local stack

When Run a call that falls back from Haiku to Mistral, a normal call, and an ai.* call

Then For text generation: the diagnostics row names the answering model, with fellBackFrom set when the call fell back from Haiku to Mistral; the audit row names disclosed_to aws_bedrock and the model (PF-04-02); an ai.* text call records its vendor without recording the PHI.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in api/provider-fallback.spec.ts and api/audit.spec.ts. UAT 3.9 'record which AI ran each step', for the text-generation steps only. Speech-to-text recording is S12 (unit tests) and TC-23 S08; photo-model recording is TC-02 U10 and is not checked by these tests.

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

Existing specs:

  • api/audit.spec.ts [api] — an ai.* call records the disclosure without recording the PHI — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-01 log shows the answering model — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-02 audit row shows it too — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api specs e2e/api/provider-fallback.spec.ts and e2e/api/audit.spec.ts): provider-fallback stubs bedrock.invoke in-process, and audit.spec signs in a local fixture account and reads audit rows through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one share…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
